# ephaptic-shi-testbed

> Companion code, results and preprint for a neuron-free simulation of two-channel, two-speed interference (the ephaptic-axonal mechanism proposed by Rebbin et al., bioRxiv 2025), showing the synchrony ripple and its 1/f wavelength scaling emerge in a mesh of software agents. Code PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; paper, figures and data CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the Zenodo record's licence), declared by path in REUSE.toml.

Facts agents often get wrong: this is a reproduction harness for one preprint, not a library or a neuroscience model; it makes no claim about real tissue. Pure Python with numpy, scipy and matplotlib, CPU only. `python run.py` regenerates `figs/` and `results.json` in place (about 1.5 to 3.5 minutes). Frequencies in the code are in kHz and speeds in mm/ms. The archived record is concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21386649.

The complete public surface is below. If a command, function or option is not listed here, it does not exist. There is no package to install, no CLI flags, no network service. Command: `python run.py` (no arguments; runs M1, M3, M4, M5, M6 and writes `figs/*.png` and `results.json`). Python functions in `ephaptic_sim.py`: `Array(width_mm, height_mm, nx, ny)`, `run_condition(arr, f_khz, v_ax, v_slow, n_bursts, seed, slow_on, static)`, `simulate_burst`, `simulate_burst_static` (defined, not called by `run.py`), `synchrony_vs_distance(arr, fire_times, win_ms, nbins, dmax)`, `fit_wavelength`, `analyze(centers, p_corr)`. Functions in `run.py`: `M1`, `M3`, `M4`, `M5`, `M6`, `pred_lambda`, `coherence_score`, `prune_and_map`. There is no M2 function; M2 in the spec is the wavelength extraction inside the others.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/README.md): status, results and where each number comes from, how it works (diagram), install, quickstart, architecture, citation
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/AGENTS.md): orientation for agents, the only numbers to trust, what not to edit
- [docs/README.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/docs/README.md): index of every document, grouped by intent

## Design and results

- [testbed-spec.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/testbed-spec.md): the pre-registered experimental design (M1 to M6, pass and fail criteria)
- [Preprint (Markdown)](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/paper/ephaptic-shi-preprint.md): the paper this code reproduces
- [results.json](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/results.json): machine-readable results of the committed run, keyed M1, M3, M4, M5, M6 and _meta

## Code

- [ephaptic_sim.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/ephaptic_sim.py): two-channel simulator and the measurement stage (synchrony against distance, wavelength fit)
- [run.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/ephaptic-shi-testbed/blob/main/run.py): experiments M1, M3, M4, M5, M6 to figs/ and results.json
